notes.title: Taipei Game Show Version Released! "Who is the Defendant: Deliberately Rough" is Now Free to Play
notes.notes:
The highly acclaimed, intriguingly artistic courtroom game! "Who is the Defendant: Deliberately Rough" is now available for free on Steam.

https://youtu.be/qnV1jmTOOLw

"Who is the Defendant: Deliberately Rough" is a mystery game for PC, serving as a special exhibition edition of the developing game "The Real Face of a VTuber". Players take on the role of a prosecutor, accusing a malicious developer who showcased a game with deliberately rough art at a game exhibition. This has now been adapted into a special Steam version and released as a free game for interested players to experience.

https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44915859/76769eb81da715bf610e369cb3b69fbea8865722.png

Players will prosecute the malicious developer for "deceiving players with deliberately rough art," with the accused being none other than the development team, "Lilien Games". The game features amusing and "artistic" visuals, including a defense attorney unhappy with their appearance, a relieved prosecutor who wasn't targeted, and a witness bullied for having a complete sprite. The indictment's premise is sure to bring a smile to players' faces.

https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44915859/9f55b26888c3cebc9eccba7dfa3ba1c5d44792b9.png

As a special exhibition edition, the game itself boasts a high level of completeness. Players can name the protagonist, experience two courtroom phases ("Prosecution Witness Interrogation" and "Defense Witness Interrogation"), and achieve four different outcomes based on their actions, even earning a certificate of qualification. Despite its promotional nature, the game still offers an enjoyable experience.

https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44915859/86c7a322d09e509323eb5a775ad8996eab803456.png

This is a game designed to promote our main game. The new game "The Real Face of a VTuber" is a VTuber-themed mystery and puzzle game. However, due to the deadline for the game exhibition registration, the core VTuber artwork was not yet complete, leading to the creation of this special edition. Now, "The Real Face of a VTuber" has its Steam store page up and is scheduled for release in Q4 2024. We invite interested players to download "Who is the Defendant: Deliberately Rough" and get an early taste of the whimsical story style and courtroom debate gameplay.

https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44915859/0533bde9849b5fc61c36ea69d98283e76e4c9b4a.png

"Who is the Defendant: Deliberately Rough" is available in Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, English, and Japanese, and is free to play on Steam.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2988880/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2871140/

notes.title: Congratulations! Game wins award/version update.
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We have some great news to share!

Our game, "Who is the Criminal," has won the Silver Award in the Taiwan Indie Game category at the Taipei Game Show's "Game Star" competition! Congratulations to our team!

We never expected to win, especially with the game's retro style. To celebrate, we created a four-panel comic expressing our feelings about this achievement.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41215530/7728bced1742ea723db41d77e3973f4b19bd29ce.png

We're also offering a seven-day discount for those who are interested in buying the game but haven't yet taken the plunge. Don't miss out on this opportunity!

Additionally, many players have expressed their dissatisfaction with our game's loop system, and we've listened. We've optimized it, and now players can skip to the next chapter after completing a level.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41215530/fd488604653d0081e751c23ccd350a909a75b131.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41215530/659e81205cc32eb329a2174cc2f95619f4784968.png

Although it may not be the prettiest solution, we hope to improve it in future updates.

We're already planning our next project and can't wait to challenge you all with another set of mysteries! Please follow our social media pages for updates.

LILIEN GAMES FB

Lastly, we want to thank all our players for their support. We appreciate it from the bottom of our hearts.

Sincerely,

LILIEN GAMES
